translations.web: A shoot will come out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will bear fruit.
translations.bsb: Then a shoot will spring up from the stump of Jesse, and a Branch from his roots will bear fruit.
translations.kjv: And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots:
translations.asv: And there shall come forth a shoot out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots shall bear fruit.
